Position Title:LeadSubstationEngineer

Position Location:Remote - workvirtually fromanywhere in the United States

Job Summary

DLB is expanding its utility and substation engineering services and is seeking a Lead Substation Engineer to helpestablish, grow, and technically lead this service. This roleis responsible forthe end-to-end engineering delivery of medium- and high-voltage substations across utility, renewable, data center, and industrial markets, from concept through construction and commissioning.

The Lead Substation Engineer will provide technical direction, make final engineering decisions, and represent the firm with clients, utilities, and partners. This position is both hands-on and strategic, blending detailed engineering execution with mentorship, quality oversight, and support of business growth.

The Lead Substation Engineer is self-directed on day-to-day work and receives high level instruction on new projects, tasks,or assignments. Will execute and lead teams and projects,tasksor assignments of complex scope.  May coordinate activities of other personnel.

TheLeadSubstationEngineer will communicate and operate in line with organizational goals and values, as well as departmental objectives.

Essential Functions

Substation Engineering Technical Leadership (40%)

  • Serve as the lead engineer and technical authority for substation projects, independently directing engineering execution with minimal oversight. Independently perform advanced engineering work through leading and overseeing the design,analysisand engineering of medium to high voltage electrical systems (including substations), ensuring compliance with customer requirements, utility requirements, industry standards,codesand regulations
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to integrate substation designs seamlessly into larger electrical systems, including grid infrastructure and power distribution networks
  • Act as the primary decision-maker for engineering approaches, design standards, and technical risk management.
  • Lead projects as engineer of record (or support EOR), taking full responsibility for technical accuracy, constructability, and code compliance.
  • Establish, implement, and enforce engineering standards, design criteria, and quality expectations forsubstationwork.

Lead Substation Engineering Design Activities (25%)

  • Independently lead and perform detailed design for:
  • Substation one-line, three-line, and AC/DC schematics
  • Physical layouts, elevations, and equipment arrangements (AIS/GIS)
  • Bus configurations (ring bus, breaker-and-a-half, double bus, etc.)
  • Grounding systems and electrical safety designs
  • Protection & control philosophies, relay schemes, and coordination
  • Control house layouts, panel arrangements, and cablerouting
  • Develop and review equipment specifications for major substation components including transformers, breakers, disconnects, instrument transformers, protection relays, and communications systems.
  • Perform and/or direct complex engineering studies with minimal guidance
  • Ensure compliance with applicable standards and utility requirements while independently resolving technical conflicts and ambiguities.
  • Utilize AutoCAD and Revit software to prepare drawings and visual aids
  • Timely and effective management of project design team including resource forecasting and coordination
  • Identifypotential project scope changes and aid in development of strategies to minimize impact and control deviations from estimated costs and project deadlines

Project Execution / Pre-Construction / Client Interface (25%)

  • Responsible for execution of the firm’s client value system and assuring that the project is executedin accordance withcompany policies and standards
  • Work closely with clients to understand their specific project requirements,providetechnical insights, and ensure client satisfaction throughout the project lifecycle
  • Resolve design, construction, and field issues independently, escalating only when business or contractual risk requires leadership involvement.
  • Support construction, testing, commissioning, and energization through RFIs, field engineering, and technical troubleshooting.
  • Lead technical reviews, design meetings, and client presentations with minimal preparation oversight.
  • Prepare project design and construction documents

Reporting (10%)

  • Prepare project progress reports for internal and external stakeholders
  • Update andmaintainshop drawing andRFIlog
  • Manage personal hours using company tools

Technology, Digital Tools & AI-Enabled Efficiency

  • Identifyopportunities and lead the strategic use of technology, digital platforms, and AI-enabled tools to enhance efficiency through workflow automation, reduced manual effort, and improved accuracy in forecasting, documentation, reporting, and quality processes.
  • Support adoption of emerging technologies - including advanced analytics, data visualization tools, and digital construction management platforms - to strengthen readiness, quality assurance, and project controls.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure technology solutions align with DLB standards for data security, privacy, and operational integrity.
  • Promote a culture that embraces innovation, continuous improvement, and the strategic use of technology tooptimizeperformance and scalability.

Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget

Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned

Position Requirements (Advanced level for all the following)

  • Knowledge of electrical systems found in buildings including single/three phase power distribution, lighting and lighting controls,groundingand life safety systems
  • Knowledge of various electrical topologies and distribution systems
  • Strong working knowledge of applicable electrical codes and standards (NEC, NFPA, NESC, IEEE, ANSI, utility standards), with ability to apply requirements through code analysis and system design.
  • Knowledge of technical / design software including short circuit coordination and arc flash studies, equipment sizing, underground feedercalculationsand lighting calculations
  • Skilled at using MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams), along with exceptional organizational skills for file management
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail, able to manage multiple tasks simultaneously and meet tight deadlines under pressure.
  • Ability toleverageAI and emerging technologies to streamline workflows,optimizeoperational processes, and contribute to company-wide innovation.
  • Ability to work successfully in a remote environmentthrougheffective communication and organizational skills, self-motivation, proactiveness and resourcefulness in a distraction free workspace
  • Ability to follow company and site safety requirements
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences and serve as a client-facing point of contact.
  • Ability to effectively plan and delegate the work of others

Physical Demands

The following physical demands must be met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonableaccommodationmay be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is

  • Frequently required to remain in a stationary position
  • Frequently moving throughoffice,facilityand other environments
  • On occasion the employee may move equipment weighing up to 25 pounds

Travel / Relocation Requirements

  • Up to20%, this may include travel to any or all 50 US states
  • Travel is defined as physically leaving home on behalf of business activities including but not limited to client sites, meetings with other employees,meetingsfor business development purposes, running errands on behalf of the business, attending industry conferences, etc.

Education / Experience

  • Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering
  • Professional Engineer (PE) license
  • 8+ years of substation design engineering experience
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary substation design and working directly with utilities and owner engineering teams on utility, renewable, data center, or industrial projects

Benefits

DLB Associates offers a very competitive benefits package; highlights include

  • Choice of comprehensive medical plans (including two PPO-style plans and a HDHP w/ HSA option)
  • Flex spending accounts (FSA)
  • Dental and vision plans
  • Comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits extended to spouse / domestic partner and dependent children up to age 26
  • 401k with company match and self-directed brokerage account option
  • PTO including additional paid time off during the last week of the year
  • Company paid life insurance coverage for employees and their eligible dependents
  • Short and long-term disability, AD&D coverage
  • Professional development opportunities, tuition reimbursement and professional licensing assistance
  • Paid parental leave after one year of employment

CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC residents only: In accordance with CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC law, the range provided is DLB's reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this role. The actual amount may differ based on non-discriminatory factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location.

DLB Associates is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and participates in the E-Verify program with the Department of Homeland Security. We encourage diversity in our workforce.

Are you ready to challenge yourself and redefine standards in the AEC industry? Apply now and join our award-winning team!​

raw.excerpt: Ameresco, Inc.  (NYSE:AMRC) is a leading energy solutions provider dedicated to helping customers reduce costs, enhance resilience, and decarbonize to net zero in the global energy transition.
raw.description:
Ameresco, Inc. (NYSE:AMRC) is a leading energy solutions provider dedicated to helping customers reduce costs, enhance resilience, and decarbonize to net zero in the global energy transition. We are a trusted, full-service partner to public sector and government entities, K-12 schools, higher education, utilities, and healthcare customers across the U.S., Canada, the U.K., and Europe.

At Ameresco, we show the way by developing, constructing and operating tailored smart energy efficiency solutions, distributed energy resources, and infrastructure upgrades that drive cost savings, resilience, decarbonization, and innovation. Our comprehensive portfolio is built to address the challenges of today and adapt the future, ensuring long-term sustainability and success for our customers.

Ameresco is currently seeking a Senior Process Engineer to join our Alternative Fuels team. This position is responsible for providing direction, support and resources to the gas processing plants to ensure downtime is minimized, and optimization and production goals are met.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and Procurement: Perform design calculations and prepare equipment specifications; Solicit bids from equipment suppliers and assist in procurement of mechanical equipment and instrumentation; Design LFGTE plants and high RNG facilities to include GA layout, PFD, PIDs, BOM, 2D bid drawings, routing/piping subsystem, and construction drawings.

  • Process Planning: Plan, develop, direct, and coordinate gas processes.

  • Technology Evaluation: Evaluate technological needs and integrate them into gas processing plants.

  • Quality Assurance: Stop or postpone gas processing if quality or regulatory concerns arise and coordinate resolution; Collaborate with personnel at gas processing plants to troubleshoot issues and develop maintenance practices.

  • Investigations and Reports: Conduct process and production failure investigations; Implement corrective actions and prepare reports to communicate problem/resolution/progress.

  • Engineering Support: Provide engineering support to operations (LFGTE and RNG plants) in design, instrumentation, and maintenance; Collaborate with all engineering disciplines and operations staff to understand processes and provide design input.

  • Process Improvement: Develop, evaluate, and improve gas processing methods; Modify processes to enhance safety, product quality, and cost efficiency.

  • Documentation and Communication: Create accurate P&ID drawings, BOMs, and other engineering documentation; Compile quality data, establish regular communication, and facilitate action plans for continuous improvement; Create project specifications along with Instrumentation specifications, MOC and SOPs.

  • Safety and Decision-Making: Analyze workforce utilization, space requirements, and workflow; Design layouts for equipment and workspace efficiency.

  • Technical Competence: Make decisions on proper equipment selection and application; Consider cost, value, application suitability, safety, and reliability.

  • Knowledge and Collaboration: Maintain knowledge of industry standards (ASME, AGA, API, AISC, OSHA, ASTM); Collaborate with outside vendors, contractors, and design teams to meet project specifications and deadlines.

  • Mentorship: Act as a mentor to Process Engineers within the Alternative Fuels business unit.

  • Other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in chemical engineering, process engineering or a related discipline.

  • Minimum of seven (7) years related work experience in landfill gas to energy, high BTU/RNG, oil refinery, chemical process, and/or gas process.

Additional Qualifications:

  • Professional Engineer (PE) License is preferred.

  • Technical experience with gas processing using membrane, pressure swing adsorption, and solvent adsorption processes or gas compression equipment and/or flare and thermal oxidizers is desired.

  • Knowledge and understanding of Internal Combustion Engine (ICE), crankcase ventilation system, compressors/blowers, expansion joints and HVAC systems.

  • Knowledge and understanding of fluid flow principles, thermal systems, mechanical design, and structural analysis.

  • Ability to use AutoCAD for creating process block diagrams, P&IDs, and control philosophy for landfill gas to energy facilities (LFGTE) and renewable natural gas (RNG) facilities.

  • Excellent written and oral communication skills.

  • Strong organizational, problem-solving, and analytical skills.

  • Versatility, flexibility, and a willingness to work within constantly changing priorities with enthusiasm.

  • Proficient with current Microsoft Office applications, specifically Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Access.

  • Working knowledge of data collection, data analysis, evaluation, and scientific methods.

  • Working knowledge and understanding of the basic principles, theories, concepts, and practices in the applicable area of processing engineering/technical specialization.

  • Experience communicating accurately and frequently with supervisors, manager, and engineering team.

  • Proven ability to handle multiple projects and meet deadlines.

The anticipated base salary range for this role is $97,400 - $169,250 (presented in good faith). In addition to base pay, employees receive a comprehensive benefits package, such as health insurance, retirement plans, and paid time off, and may be eligible for performance incentives, bonuses, commissions, or equity, depending on the role.

Actual pay will depend on factors such as internal equity, skills, experience, education, certifications, and location. This range supports our commitment to pay transparency and compliance with applicable laws. Compensation may vary by work location, including remote arrangements.

We disclose salary ranges and benefits in all required external and internal postings and will provide further details upon request at any stage of the hiring process. Applications are accepted on a rolling basis until the position is filled.

Ameresco challenges the brightest, most talented, and creative individuals in the industry by providing an environment that fosters initiative and achievement. We are proud of our comprehensive and competitive employee benefits, including people-oriented insurance, investment, and incentive plans.

All official communications from Ameresco will originate from an @ameresco.com email address. Any correspondence from other domains should be regarded as fraudulent. Please report any suspicious activity to the platform where the issue was encountered. For further inquiries or concerns, please contact us at 1-866-AMERESCO

Ameresco is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

You will serve as the primary liaison between Quest Software and our strategic accounts, aligning client objectives with our Data Operations and Data Intelligence solutions to drive mutual success.

À propos de TimberTec

TimberTec s'impose comme le leader technologique européen dans l'édition de solutions ERP dédiées à l'industrie et au négoce du bois et dérivés. Grâce à notre solution globale TiCom, nous orchestrons la transformation digitale de nos clients sur l’ensemble de leur chaîne de valeur, allant de l’approvisionnement par la production jusqu’à la logistique et la commercialisation.

Dans le cadre de notre expansion stratégique sur la zone France, Suisse et Benelux, nous recherchons un(e) Consultant(e) expert(e), capable de conjuguer une connaissance pointue de la filière bois avec une maîtrise rigoureuse du pilotage de projets SI.

Nous offrons un parcours d’intégration pensé pour votre réussite, à savoir :

Une période d’onboarding d’excellence : Vous bénéficiez d’un parcours d'intégration intensif et rémunéré de 3 à 6 mois au sein de notre siège à Eutin (Allemagne), pour devenir expert de nos solutions.

Une flexibilité & autonomie de travail : À l’issue de cette phase, vous travaillez essentiellement en télétravail à temps plein (Home Office) avec une gestion autonome de votre emploi du temps.

Une présence terrain : Vous assurez des déplacements réguliers (immersion sur site, phases de cadrage et déploiements) auprès de nos clients industriels sur la zone francophone pour la mise en place de nos solutions ERP.

Vos missions

En tant que Business Consultant, vous êtes l'architecte du déploiement de l'ERP TiCom. Interlocuteur privilégié entre nos clients et notre structure, vous assurez la réussite des projets de bout en bout en les conduisant avec un sens de la rigueur, une réelle expertise, ainsi qu’une méthodologie d’approche. Cela implique:

1. Audit, conseil & optimisation des processus

  • Conduire de manière autonome les ateliers de diagnostic pour modéliser les flux existants.

  • Conseiller les clients sur l'optimisation de leur chaîne opérationnelle avec nos solutions logicielles, de la planification de production, gestion des stocks, logistique, l’ADV et SCM.

  • Concevoir les processus cibles et définir la trajectoire de digitalisation la plus performante.

2. Pilotage du déploiement & configuration continue

  • Piloter l’implémentation de manière autonome (gestion du planning, des ressources et des jalons critiques).

  • Superviser le paramétrage fonctionnel et coordonner les experts techniques internes pour répondre aux spécificités métiers.

  • Orchestrer les phases de tests, la recette, la formation des utilisateurs et garantir la stabilisation post-démarrage.

3. Partenariat stratégique & industrie 4.0

  • Inscrire la relation client dans la durée en tant que référent fonctionnel de confiance.

  • Accompagner vos clients vers les standards de l’Industrie 4.0 grâce à la flexibilité de nos solutions.

Votre Profil

Critères impératifs (Qualités requises indispensables au poste):

Une expertise du bois: Vous possédez une expérience concrète dans l’industrie du bois (scierie, 2è transformation, négoce) ou dans un environnement industriel à flux complexes lié à l’environnement du bois (transformation, planification de production).

Une expérience ERP (5 ans min.): Vous avez déjà piloté ou activement participé à l’implémentation de systèmes d’information complexes dans un environnement B2B industriel.

Une capacité d’analyse: Vous savez transformer des problématiques métiers complexes en solutions structurées et opérationnelles.

Un niveau linguistique: Le français (langue de travail) ; une maîtrise de l’Allemand et/ou de l’Anglais (niveau C1 minimum) est indispensable pour la collaboration interne et pendant la phase de formation. Toutes autre compétence linguistique (de type espagnol, italien, suédois) serait un plus.

Mobilité : Permis B requis pour des déplacements réguliers sur la zone France, Suisse et Benelux.

Atouts complémentaires:

Maîtrise des méthodologies de gestion de projet (Agile ou Cycle en V).

Compréhension des fondamentaux inhérent à la filière bois.

Aisance interculturelle pour la communication interne/externe.

Modalités de candidature

Afin que nous puissions évaluer au mieux votre adéquation avec ce poste, nous vous remercions de préciser dans votre candidature:

Vos expériences marquantes dans la filière bois (types de projets, durée, entreprises).

Votre rôle spécifique lors de déploiements ou de gestions de projets ERP/SI.

Veuillez noter que ces informations sont essentielles pour l'étude de votre dossier.

The ideal candidate enjoys solving complex problems, building systems that scale, and partnering across teams to help a high growth company move quickly while maintaining strong financial discipline. Job Summary:

The AI Solution Consultant serves as the primary "Face of AI" for CareSource business units, acting as a strategic bridge between clinical/operational domains and the technical AI Platform team. This role is responsible for driving the enterprise-wide intake and triage process, stratifying opportunities into Green (Self-Service), Yellow (Citizen Dev), and Red (Pro-Code) tiers. The Consultant partners directly with business executives to define high-value use cases, modeling ROI and ensuring alignment with the organization's mission to improve member experience and health outcomes.

Essential Functions:
  • Lead the common intake process for all AI initiatives, utilizing the "Traffic Light" framework to stratify requests into green, yellow, or red risk tiers.
  • Conduct Art of the Possible workshops and discovery sessions with business leaders (Clinical, Claims, Ops) to identify high-ROI opportunities for agentic and generative AI.
  • Develop robust business cases and value assessments, including projected efficiency gains, cost reductions, and quality improvements, for presentation to the AI Steering Committee (AISC).
  • Act as a trusted advisor to citizen developers in the yellow layer, guiding them toward approved low-code tools (UiPath, Databricks) and ensuring architectural alignment.
  • Partner with the AIEC to define functional requirements for complex red layer clinical agents, ensuring clarity on human-in-the-loop needs.
  • Serve as the primary liaison between business product owners and the AI Platform Engineering team, translating business needs into technical user stories.
  • Evaluate AI usage within business units and migrate unauthorized tools into the managed green or yellow layer governance structures.
  • Monitor and report on the value realization of deployed solutions, tracking actual vs. projected ROI and operational throughput uplift.
  • Assist in the creation of domain-specific prompt libraries to accelerate adoption of Microsoft 365 Copilot within specific departments (e.g., HR, Finance).
  • Facilitate user acceptance testing (UAT) coordination between the business stakeholders and the IT development teams for red layer builds.
  • Provide consultative support for yellow layer exceptions, helping power users navigate the IT review and approval gates.
  • Maintain a deep understanding of the evolving AI landscape (Agentic workflows, RAG) to proactively suggest innovation opportunities to business partners.
  • Perform any other job related duties as requested.

Education and Experience:
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Business, or a related field required
  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Business, or a related field preferred
  • Equivalent years of relevant work experience may be accepted in lieu of required education
  • Eight (8) years of experience in IT Consulting, Solution Architecture, or Technical Product Management required
  • Experience leading digital transformation initiatives, defining ROI models, and shaping business strategy required
Competencies, Knowledge and Skills:
  • Strategic consulting skills, with the ability to lead Art of the Possible workshops and influence senior business leaders
  • Deep Healthcare Payer industry knowledge (Utilization Management, Claims, Prior Auth)
  • Proficiency in Generative AI concepts, capable of explaining the difference between Deterministic (Rules-based) and Probabilistic (AI) systems to non-tech audiences
  • Strong business case development skills, able to model financial impacts (OpEx savings, productivity gains)
  • Ability to navigate "Traffic Light" governance, guiding business teams on whether a request is Green (Self-service), Yellow (Low-code), or Red (Pro-code)
  • Familiar with Low-Code platforms (UiPath, Power Platform) to advise on "Yellow Layer" citizen development opportunities

  • TOGAF or Zachman Framework certification preferred
  • SAFe Agilist or similar Agile Architecture certification preferred

Overview

Bruker is enabling scientists to make breakthrough discoveries and develop new applications that improve the quality of human life. Bruker’s high performance scientific instruments and high value analytical and diagnostic solutions enable scientists to explore life and materials at molecular, cellular, and microscopic levels. In close cooperation with our customers, Bruker is enabling innovation, improved productivity, and customer success in life science molecular and cell biology research, in applied and pharma applications, in microscopy and nanoanalysis, as well as in industrial applications. Today, worldwide more than 8500 employees are working on this permanent challenge at over 90 locations. Bruker offers differentiated, high-value life science and diagnostics systems and solutions in preclinical imaging, clinical phenomics research, proteomics and multiomics, spatial and single-cell biology, functional structural and condensate biology, as well as in clinical microbiology and molecular diagnostics.

Please visit www.bruker.com.

Responsibilities

As a Senior Analyst - Production/Planning, your responsibilities include:

Material Planning & Forecasting

  • Lead monthly S&OP meetings to consolidate demand forecasts and align material requirements
  • Maintain accurate forecasts in SAP and ensure supplier and stakeholder alignment
  • Drive corrective actions for planning discrepancies and system mismatches

Customer Order Slot Allocation

  • Review technical specifications and customer order requests to determine feasible production slots
  • Coordinate with Purchasing, Production, and Order Management to confirm delivery timelines
  • Ensure timely updates in SFDC and SAP for all customer orders

Clear-to-Build Validation

  • Conduct readiness checks for upcoming production batches using SFDC and SAP
  • Validate material availability and technical documentation for execution release
  • Communicate production readiness and escalate issues proactively

Product Lifecycle (PLC) Integration

  • Participate in ECN meetings and integrate engineering changes into planning workflows
  • Ensure timely ECI closures and clean execution readiness across warehouse and work orders

Factory Performance Analysis

  • Analyze missed On-Time Delivery (OTD) cases and classify root causes
  • Update SFDC reports and support continuous improvement initiatives

System Housekeeping

  • Monitor and correct backdated demand in SAP to maintain data integrity
  • Ensure planning data is reliable for downstream purchasing and production processes

Tools & Systems

  • SAP ERP (MM, PP modules)
  • SFDC (Salesforce)
  • Excel (Advanced reporting and analysis)

Qualifications

To be successful for this position, you shall possess:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Business, or related field
  • 5+ years of experience in production planning or supply chain within high-tech or scientific manufacturing
  • Strong command of SAP and SFDC systems is a must
  • Advance level with Microsoft Excel - analisys., dashboard, reporting
  • Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills
  • Experience working in a regulated or ISO-certified manufacturing environment is a plus

The Opportunity:

CACI is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior ServiceNow Developer supporting the Department of the Air Force (DAF) Enterprise IT as a Service (EITaaS) program. This role is responsible for the design, development, configuration, implementation, and ongoing optimization of our ServiceNow Software Asset Management (SAM) Pro module. The successful candidate will leverage their deep understanding of the ServiceNow platform and SAM best practices to ensure accurate license positions, drive cost savings, enhance compliance, and streamline our software lifecycle processes.

This is a hands-on technical role that requires strong development capabilities within the ServiceNow platform, particularly with SAM Pro, combined with excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

Responsibilities:

ServiceNow SAM Pro Development & Configuration:

  • Design, develop, configure, and customize the ServiceNow SAM Pro module, including Software Models, Entitlements, Discovery Models, Software Installations, Contracts, and License Positions while adhering to platform best practices.
  • Implement and maintain Publisher Packs (e.g., Microsoft, Oracle, Adobe, IBM, VMWare, Salesforce) within SAM Pro.
  • Develop and enhance SAM Pro workflows, business rules, client scripts, script includes, UI policies, and data policies.
  • Configure and optimize Discovery Sources (e.g., MECM, AD, Tanium, ServiceNow Discovery) to feed accurate software installation data into SAM Pro.
  • Develop custom integrations between SAM Pro and other systems (e.g., Procurement, HR, CMDB, Finance, external discovery tools) using REST/SOAP APIs, IntegrationHub, and other integration methods.
  • Create and maintain advanced reports, dashboards, and performance analytics within SAM Pro to provide actionable insights into software consumption and compliance.

Software Asset Management Optimization:

  • Drive the normalization and reconciliation processes within SAM Pro to ensure accurate software identification and license compliance.
  • Identify opportunities for software harvesting, optimization, and cost avoidance/savings through effective use of SAM Pro features (e.g., downgrade rights, unallocated licenses).
  • Support the implementation of process, data and controls necessary for the platform to become an Accountable Property System of Record (APSR)
  • Assist in defining and utilizing SAM administration and configuration policies and procedures within the ServiceNow platform.

System Maintenance & Support:

  • Perform regular health checks, performance tuning, and troubleshooting of the SAM Pro module.
  • Support ServiceNow platform upgrades and ensure SAM Pro functionality is maintained including operability of customizations and configurations.
  • Collaborate with IT Operations, Infrastructure, and Security teams to ensure data integrity and system stability.

raw.description:
About Aimtal LLC

Aimtal is a digital marketing agency headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, with a team and clients located worldwide. Aimtal was co-founded in 2018 by Janet Mesh, Chief Executive Officer, and David Tapia, Chief Operating Officer. With a specialization in B2B marketing, Aimtal creates and executes digital marketing strategies that convert audiences into loyal customers and drive business growth. Our consultative, creative, and data-informed approach to marketing enables our team of experts to build a strategy and deliver measurable results that drive brand awareness and business growth.

Aimtal’s core values guide our approach to collaborating and communicating with our clients and team, enabling us to approach every day with empathy and excellence. Our core values are to communicate clearly, find a solution, understand the customer, keep an open mind, take the initiative, and be exceptional. Overall, our team works together to go above and beyond to support each other and our clients.

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly-skilled Video Editor (Contractor) to join our network of creative contractors. As a contractor, you will be responsible for translating raw footage into high-impact, polished video assets that align with our clients' brand strategies. We are looking for a professional who possesses a "director’s eye" for storytelling and the technical mastery to execute projects independently from kickoff to final delivery.

This is a project-based contractor role. You will be expected to have access to and manage your own workload and editing software, delivering high-quality videos that meet specific technical requirements.

Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Post-Production: Take complete ownership of the editing process, including media organization, ingestion, assembly, color grading, and sound mixing.
  • Storytelling & Narrative: Splice raw footage from various sources to create cohesive, engaging stories that align with the project brief's narrative agenda.
  • Motion Graphics & Finishing: Create and integrate static and motion graphics, titling, and transitions to elevate the production value. Static assets and designs will always be provided by graphic designers on Figma.
  • Multi-Platform Optimization: Deliver final renders tailored to specific platforms (e.g., 9:16 for TikTok/Reels, 16:9 for YouTube, GIFs, and short-form teasers), ensuring all specs meet platform-specific best practices.
  • Asset Management: Independently source high-quality stock footage, music, and SFX that align with the creative direction of the video.
  • Quality Control: Perform rigorous quality control on all deliverables to ensure they are free of technical errors and align perfectly with brand guidelines before submission.
  • Technical Troubleshooting: Manage all software, hardware, and export configurations necessary to meet delivery deadlines. By standard, we usually work with After Effects and Adobe Premiere and you are required to have your own subscription of this software.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of video editing experience
  • A robust portfolio, reel, and/or sample work demonstrating high-level storytelling, pacing, and technical proficiency across various industries. SaaS (Software as a Service) and B2B (Business-to-Business) experience is preferred.
  • Expert-level command of Adobe Premiere Pro. Proficiency in Adobe Audition, Figma, Photoshop, and Illustrator for asset preparation is required.
  • Experience editing audio, music, and incorporating sound effects
  • Intermediate to Advanced skill in motion graphics in After Effects (keyframing, typography, and 2D visual effects), and knowledge and experience in understanding motion design concepting and storyboarding are essential for this role
  • An understanding of video ad placement across marketing channels
  • Strong communication and organizational skills to manage multiple projects simultaneously
  • Good time-management skills
  • Willing to take and provide feedback like a champ!
  • Experience within an agency, in-house agency, or post-production studio is a plus
  • At least 3-5+ years of experience in an agency or post-production house environment, managing multiple client projects simultaneously.
  • Communication: Ability to process creative briefs and feedback "like a pro," implementing revisions quickly and accurately with minimal back-and-forth. Depending on the complexity of the revision requests, the expected turnaround time is usually 2 working days or less.

Availability & Logistics

  • Immediate Start: We are looking for a contractor who has the availability to begin project work immediately.
  • Project Availability : Availability to scale hours up or down based on project volume.
  • Equipment: Must possess a high-end editing workstation capable of handling 4K footage and complex renders, along with a reliable, high-speed internet connection for large file transfers.
